posts.title: Lobbies, tags and regions
posts.body:
You can now browse public rooms, filter by tag and region, and join with a code.
Host migration is still being tested.

posts.title: Voice chat added
posts.body: Proximity voice is in. You hear other players from their head.

posts.title: Welcome to Monke Game
posts.body: Thanks for playing the early build! Tell us what you think.
